headline: Uganda Shilling Plunges to 33-Year Low Against U.S. Dollar
summary: The Uganda shilling weakened to 4,500 against the dollar on October 23, marking its lowest level in 33 years as the Treasury warned against spending reserves on speculators.
why: Depreciating local currencies increase import costs, exacerbate domestic inflationary pressures, and strain foreign exchange reserves in developing economies.

impacts.name: Uganda
impacts.why: A multi-decade currency low raises import costs and pressures foreign debt servicing capacity.
